description: Webhook alerts when Polymarket traders trade, for 7 days: up to 5 wallets (signer or proxy) and a minimum size (default $500). We read each trader's trades about every 30 minutes and POST a signed JSON alert per new trade at or over that size: side, market, outcome, size, price, USD, tx. Returns an id and an HMAC secret; GET /watch/<id> is free. Renew with {id}. Not advice. Costs $0.05 USDC on Base via x402.

id.description: Renew this subscription for 7 more days instead of creating one

minUsd.description: Smallest trade (shares x price, USD) that alerts; default 500, at least 10

traders.description: Up to 5 Polymarket wallets (signer or proxy), comma-separated; omit when renewing

webhook.description: Public https URL that receives the alerts (POST, JSON); omit when renewing

name: polymarket_trader_alerts

checks.description: string, e.g. "none: the webhook is our test sink, which drops deliveries,

signature.description: string, e.g. "Each webhook is a JSON POST with header x-onchaincheck-sign
